_comment: Rome's hand-authored progression (DESIGN §6) plus random filler. Kinds: deliver (resources), build (building tier), recruits (militia), host (an official; costs denarii and resolves after N rounds). Rewards: denarii, scrolls, unlocks, gravitas.

progression.title: Survey the road
progression.text: The legate at Mogontiacum asks for timber to mark the road east.

progression.title: Raise a waystation
progression.text: A waystation on the road will carry Rome's letters and Rome's gold.

progression.title: Grain for the Rhine forts
progression.text: The garrisons on the river are short. Send grain.

progression.title: Recruits for the auxilia
progression.text: Rome asks for men. They will not come back.

progression.title: Host the quaestor
progression.text: A quaestor tours the frontier. House him well.

progression.title: Strengthen the castellum
progression.text: The legate wants walls he can point to.

progression.title: Iron for the smiths
progression.text: The legion's smiths at Vetera need iron.

progression.title: Quarter a cohort
progression.text: A cohort winters with you. Your militia stands down while it does.

progression.title: A temple for the colony
progression.text: A colonia without an altar to Jupiter is a camp.

progression.title: Clay for the kilns
progression.text: The forts want tiles. Send clay.

progression.title: A proper forum
progression.text: Rome expects a basilica worthy of the name.

progression.title: More recruits
progression.text: The auxilia grow. So must your contribution.

progression.title: Host the legate
progression.text: The legate himself comes east. Everything must be right.

progression.title: Grain for the campaign
progression.text: The legions march in spring. They eat.

progression.title: The basilica
progression.text: Raise the forum to its full height. Rome will remember it.

filler.title: Grain for the forts
filler.text: The river garrisons are short again.

filler.title: Clay for the tileries
filler.text: Roof tiles for the new barracks.

filler.title: Recruits
filler.text: A few men for the auxilia.

catapult.name: Catapult
catapult.description: A defence bonus now; an offensive engine later.

engineer.name: Engineer
engineer.description: A military engineer on loan. Construction is faster.

veteran_cohort.name: Veteran cohort
veteran_cohort.description: Discharged veterans settle here. The militia pool grows.

citizenship_grant.name: Citizenship grant
citizenship_grant.description: Rome confirms your house's standing. Your leader gains gravitas.
